description: User asks about their loan burden / EMI pressure, loan terms, rates, tenure, or refinancing. Read-only advisory intent. BOUNDARY RULE (2026-07-19): prepayment/payoff/debt-free what-ifs belong to DEBT_FREEDOM_ANALYSIS — this intent owns TERMS (rate, tenure, refinance, consolidation, new-loan burden), that one owns FREEDOM (payoff date, extra payments, lump sums). 43 of 45 WHAT_IF patterns here previously used debt-freedom language, training two intents on the same meaning; the classifier flipped between them across runs.
